attempts.sql: WITH kinds(kind) AS (SELECT 'class' AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 'function' UNION ALL SELECT 'method'), public_counts AS (SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM code.symbols AS s INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE s.is_public = TRUE AND substr(s.name, 1, 1) <> '_' AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND s.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND ((s.kind = 'class' AND s.qualname = s.name) OR (s.kind = 'function' AND s.qualname = s.name) OR s.kind = 'method') GROUP BY s.kind) SELECT k.kind, COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS public_count FROM kinds AS k LEFT JOIN public_counts AS pc ON k.kind = pc.kind ORDER BY CASE k.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END;

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public classes, module-level functions, and methods in non-test source files under the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo package, excluding its tests folder. It uses the public flag and the symbol name to exclude private names, and it excludes nested classes and nested functions. Results are grouped by symbol kind and returned in the order class, function, method, with zero counts included for any kind that has no matching symbols.
sql: WITH kinds(kind) AS (SELECT 'class' AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 'function' UNION ALL SELECT 'method'), public_counts AS (SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM code.symbols AS s INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE s.is_public = TRUE AND substr(s.name, 1, 1) <> '_' AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND s.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND ((s.kind = 'class' AND s.qualname = s.name) OR (s.kind = 'function' AND s.qualname = s.name) OR s.kind = 'method') GROUP BY s.kind) SELECT k.kind, COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS public_count FROM kinds AS k LEFT JOIN public_counts AS pc ON k.kind = pc.kind ORDER BY CASE k.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END;
